requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Name three types of physical genealogical resources and where you can find them, and explain how these resources can help you chart your family tree. (b) Name three types of digital genealogical resources and where you can find them, and explain how these resources can help you chart your family tree. (c) Obtain at least one genealogical document that supports an event that is or can be recorded on your pedigree chart or family group record. (d) Tell how you found it and how you would evaluate the genealogical information you found for requirement 4(c). (e) Tell a likely place to find these type of genealogical records: marriage record, census record, birth record, and burial information.
